an8.87:1.1: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa upāsakassa ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pattaṃ nikkujjeyya.
an8.87:1.3: bhikkhūnaṃ alābhāya parisakkati bhikkhūnaṃ anatthāya parisakkati bhikkhūnaṃ anāvāsāya parisakkati bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vibhedeti buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati saṅghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
an8.87:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahaṅgehi samannāgatassa upāsakassa ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pattaṃ nikkujjeyya. 105
an8.87:2.1: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa upāsakassa ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pattaṃ ukkujjeyya.
an8.87:2.3: na bhikkhūnaṃ alābhāya parisakkati na bhikkhūnaṃ anatthāya parisakkati na bhikkhūnaṃ anāvāsāya parisakkati na bhikkhū akkosati paribhāsati na bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vibhedeti buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
an8.87:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahaṅgehi samannāgatassa upāsakassa ākaṅkhamāno saṅgho pattaṃ ukkujjeyyāti. 106
